title: A field transition invalidates the prior Wild handle and rebinds the actor

verification.actor: One prepared WILD Rattata with a verified live handle and attached presentation
verification.trigger: After one natural Rattata Walk, use normal player input to cross from Route29 into Cherrygrove and take one recovery step
verification.observable: The actor owner advances field epoch and map generation once, emits CONTEXT_CHANGED then ACTOR_REBOUND, invalidates the old full handle, retains current Wild identity, and returns normal player control

setupMutations.change: Create one Rattata through the shared native spawn adapter at the saved Route29 start. This selects the subject only; it gives no motion, route, transition, or recovery credit.

limits: Covers one Wild actor and one Route29-to-Cherrygrove boundary.
Does not prove retained follower or mount rebind, indoor transitions, or long-run streaming.

events.value: Spawn and bind one exact Rattata at the saved Route29 start
Observe one complete natural Wild Walk
Walk the short normal route through the Cherrygrove field boundary
Observe context loss, actor rebind, old-handle invalidation, and one settled recovery step

stop.condition: One map change, the Wild actor has a current rebound handle, and the player settles one tile inside Cherrygrove

invariants: The bound Wild actor completes one natural Walk before the transition
The field epoch and map generation each advance exactly once
The old Wild handle is absent after the transition
The rebound Wild actor retains its subject and current engine identity
Every active actor on the new map uses the current field context
Normal player control completes one recovery step
